title: Potatoverse Character Archive — Role × Time × Source
purpose: Preserve the full long-tail cast without forcing every person/handle into a permanent role or a dedicated Room.

source_manifest.name: Characters1.odt
source_manifest.use: aliases, old role labels, relationships, proposed story functions
source_manifest.warning: Contains speculative psychology, hostile rhetoric, unverified allegations and future-arc guesses. These are never promoted as facts without source recovery.

source_manifest.name: Characters.rtf
source_manifest.warning: Treat as historical authored interpretation, not a clinical or legal record.

source_manifest.name: Chronicles of The Potato of Life.txt / .rtf
source_manifest.use: date-window appearances, scene roles, social texture, changing functions
source_manifest.warning: Narrative retelling may paraphrase or mythologize original chat; it is not automatically verbatim documentary evidence.

source_manifest.name: Tims Biography.docx / Tims Biography Full.odt
source_manifest.use: broader period context and role transitions
source_manifest.warning: Retrospective mythic interpretation must remain distinct from independently corroborated biography.

governing_rules: Person is not archetype. An archetype is a role performed in one or more scenes.
A role can change over time; old labels do not become permanent identity.
A missing current trace means current presence unknown, not dead, gone, hostile or reconciled.
Deceased status is recorded only where separately established in the project; afterlife placement is not inferred.
Old psychological diagnoses, threat scores and motive claims are downgraded to historical source characterization unless supported by direct evidence.
Aliases remain candidate links when identity equivalence is uncertain.
Dedicated Rooms are scarce. Most figures live here or in role constellations until repeated independent material justifies a Room.
The myth may preserve a seed, function or memory even when the person no longer participates.

room_policy.own-room-existing: Already has a dedicated being/cast room.
room_policy.own-room-candidate: Enough recurring structure to justify a future long-form dossier/room if source recovery continues.
room_policy.cluster: Belongs in an archetype constellation and can later graduate.
room_policy.archive-only: Keep searchable with chronology and source notes; do not create frontend architecture yet.

gardener-sage.label: Gardener / Sage
gardener-sage.function: Cultivates people, ideas, rooms or soil; teaches by tending rather than merely commanding.

witness-observer.label: Witness / Observer
witness-observer.function: Notices, questions, remembers or reflects a scene back to the group.

chronicler-archivist.label: Chronicler / Archivist
chronicler-archivist.function: Preserves moments, clips, histories, maps or lore so events survive beyond the immediate room.

bard-jester.label: Bard / Jester
bard-jester.function: Uses humor, hype, poetry, absurdity or performance to change the emotional weather.

guardian-defender.label: Guardian / Defender
guardian-defender.function: Protects a person, boundary, principle or community from attack or confusion.

healer-companion.label: Healer / Companion
healer-companion.function: Creates reassurance, belonging, practical care or emotional stabilization.

skeptic-contrarian.label: Skeptic / Contrarian
skeptic-contrarian.function: Tests claims, introduces friction or forces the group to articulate what it believes.

trickster-catalyst.label: Trickster / Catalyst
trickster-catalyst.function: Destabilizes the scene, exposes assumptions or accelerates change through disruption.

wanderer-threshold.label: Wanderer / Threshold Walker
wanderer-threshold.function: Moves between groups, loyalties, rooms or worldviews; often reveals the boundary by crossing it.

mystic-interpreter.label: Mystic / Interpreter
mystic-interpreter.function: Reads events through religion, symbolism, myth, metaphysics or hidden-pattern language.

builder-cultivator.label: Builder / Cultivator
builder-cultivator.function: Makes tangible things, supports infrastructure, grows food/art/community or maintains a shared space.

artisan-maker.label: Artisan / Maker
artisan-maker.function: Turns experience into art, craft, music, food, objects or other durable fruit.

historian-memory.label: Historian / Memory Keeper
historian-memory.function: Carries older context, nostalgia or continuity across generations of the community.

herald-messenger.label: Herald / Messenger
herald-messenger.function: Announces, preaches, relays or amplifies a message into another part of the network.

mirror-foil.label: Mirror / Foil
mirror-foil.function: Defines another character by contrast; may expose tension around control, authenticity, faith or status.

sovereign-warrior.label: Sovereign / Warrior
sovereign-warrior.function: Occupies a commanding or combative social role while carrying themes of loyalty, survival or rule.

patron-supporter.label: Patron / Supporter
patron-supporter.function: Provides encouragement, resources, donations or simple social reinforcement.

shadow-adversary.label: Shadow / Adversary
shadow-adversary.function: Old-source narrative role for opposition, conflict or threat. This is a story function, not a permanent moral or psychological diagnosis.

seeker-student.label: Seeker / Student
seeker-student.function: Learns through questions, doubt, experiments or movement from one interpretation toward another.

center-axis.label: Center / Axis
center-axis.function: A scene-organizing figure around whom relationships, interpretations or conflicts are arranged.
